[[Lift Operator Shulz]] is the operator of the Kurzick lift, that takes people from the [[Arborstone (explorable area)]] to the [[Arborstone (outpost)]]. If the player character arrives early, he will provide information on what must be done first.

==Locations==
*[[Echovald Forest]]
**{{NPC_location|Arborstone|explorable area}}

==Dialogue==
;Before [[Tahnnakai Temple]]
:''"It is my duty to guard the entrance to Arborstone and [[House zu Heltzer]]. If you have approval from the Kurzick's [[Council of Nobles]], I can arrange transport for you. Unfortunately, one of the key members on the council has been held up on a trip to [[Kaineng City]]. Apparently, there was some trouble at Tahnnakai Temple. Perhaps <[[Character]] Name> should look into that first."''

;Between Tahnnakai Temple and [[A Meeting With the Emperor]]
:''"[[Shiro]] the Destroyer is back? And he actually attacked the palace? <Character Name> should head back to [[Sunjiang District]] immediately. I'm sure the guards there can use all the help they can get. Was there something else you wanted to talk about?"''

;During A Meeting With the Emperor
:''"Some of our people traveled to Kaineng City on a diplomatic mission. They should have returned by now, but we have just learned that the emperor has been unable to see them because of some trouble at Tahnnakai Temple. <Character Name> should return to the temple and speak with the emperor. Was there something else you wanted to talk about?"''

;Between A Meeting With the Emperor and [[The Count's Daughter]]
:''"Shiro the Destroyer is back? And he actually attacked the palace? <Character Name> should head back to Sunjiang District immediately. I'm sure the guards there can use all the help they can get. Was there something else you wanted to talk about?"''

;During The Count's Daughter
:''"Some of our people traveled to Kaineng City on a diplomatic mission. They should have returned by now, but we have just learned that the emperor has been unable to see them because of some trouble at Tahnnakai Temple. <Character Name> should return to the temple and speak with the emperor. Was there something else you wanted to talk about?"''

;Alternate during The Count's Daughter, with Danika present
:''"It is my duty to guard the entrance to Arborstone. If you have approval from the council of Nobles, I can arrange transport for you.''

;Default
:''"Welcome to Arborstone and House zu Helter."''
::'''We wish to go.'''
::'''I'll be on my way.'''
